title: Engenheiro(A) De Dados Azure Sênior
description:

E convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa equipe!


Sobre a posição:

O objetivo é construir pipelines robustos, escaláveis e governados, garantindo qualidade e integração entre dados transacionais, campanhas publicitárias e plataformas de ativação.   • Monitoramento: Log Analytics e alertas.


Diferenciais (Retail Media):

  • Experiência com modelos de atribuição (last-click, multi-touch, incrementality).
  • Integração com APIs de anúncios: Google Ads, Criteo, The Trade Desk, Amazon Ads .

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal


Interview Process

  • Complete application
  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner
  • Paid project
  • Final interview with CEO/owner

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
Net-worth monitoring.
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

About the Job
Turn Key is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our Turn Key team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U. S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, Yipit Data, Work Ramp, and Bell Xcel.
We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.
Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!
Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!
A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.
*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*
O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Product owner sr
description:
Job Description A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Product Owners experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.

Entender, contribuir e influenciar os aspectos de negócios que compõem o Backlog do produto;

Contribuir para atividades de design de soluções e decisões de produto;

Experiência comprovada como Product Owner (conhecimento será testado);
Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do Scrum e SAFe;
Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade;
Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil.
Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree
Required Certifications:
Possuir certificação CSPO ou PSPO
Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)
Other: English

title: Analytics engineer - sênior
description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.
E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
Participa de iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
Apoia e pareia com analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.

Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
Diferencial Experiência em desenvolvimento de modelagens para IA em iniciativas de ML, copilots, agentes e observabilidade.

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Blockchain developer
description:
Job Description We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (d Apps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, De Fi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity. Key Responsibilities
Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
Build d Apps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (Meta Mask, Wallet Connect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting. Requirements
3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live d Apps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, Java Script/Type Script for d Apps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: De Fi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities. What We Offer
Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.

Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

We are looking for a Senior i OS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on i OS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production i OS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.
You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.

Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or Graph QL APIs and third-party libraries. Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products . Stay current with i OS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.
Minimum Qualifications 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on i OS. Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality i OS app to the App Store . Deep proficiency in Swift and Swift UI (or UIKit, depending on project needs). Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration. Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines. Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or Graph QL APIs . Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager . Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.
Preferred Qualifications Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , Core Data , or Realm . Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent). Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus. Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications. Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.

Yearly Office Allowance Budget
Macbook Purchase Support
Wellbeing Support

Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.

Vendor & Service Ownership

Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.
Project Delivery

Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.
Documentation & Enablement
Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.

5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or Saa S platform administration

AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise Saa S tools Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy

Familiarity with REST API concepts and Saa S integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
Relevant certifications (e.g., Audit Board Certified Administrator or similar)
Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Senior splunk engineer
description:
Overview
We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.
You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.
Responsibilities
1. Plan & Build
Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
Build trend and capacity analyses.
2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)
Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.
3. Configuration & Release Management
Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.
4. Security, Hardening & Compliance
System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, Su SSHi, 2 FA).
Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
Automate SOP-based operational workflows.
5. Transition
Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.
Requirements
Technical Skills
5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.
Certifications (required)
Minimum two of:
Splunk Core Certified User
Splunk Core Certified Power User
Splunk Enterprise Admin
Splunk Enterprise Architect
Optional: Splunk ES
Soft Skills
Strong communication in enterprise environments.
Clear documentation skills.
Proactive, quality-driven work style.
Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Overview
We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions. You’ll work on production Saa S systems built primarily on PHP 8 and Code Igniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.
What You’ll Do
Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout Deep-dive into existing PHP/Code Igniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets
Core Technical Requirements
Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments Hands-on experience with Code Igniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks) Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, My SQL/Maria DB, PHP, Apache/Nginx) Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
Working knowledge of Java Script, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas
Nice-to-Have (Not Required)
Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic Dev Ops workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments
What We Care About Most
Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early Comfort working independently without constant oversight
Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness
Experience Level
5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)
Working Environment
Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
High trust, low micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction
Why This Role
Real systems, real users, real problems
Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
Opportunity to be a true owner , not a ticket-taker Competitive compensation with room for growth

title: Customer success manager (brazil) — prm saas (eastern time hours)
description:
About Magentrix
Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) Saa S platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.
Role Overview
We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.
What You’ll Do
· Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets
· Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback
· Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps
· Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans
· Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers
· Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services
· Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap
Requirements (Must-Haves)
· Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs
· 5+ years in Saa S Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results
· Solution engineering capability in a Saa S environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q& A with customers
· You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative
· Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly
· Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication
· Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions
· Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)
Preferred Qualifications
· Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot)
· Exposure to global Saa S motions (serving North America/EMEA)
· Technically self-sufficient in a Saa S environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q& A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls
· Working grasp of web and Saa S fundamentals, for example and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments
· Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC
· Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion
· Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product
Location & Working Hours
· Brazil-based ( fully remote )
· Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET) working hours
What We Offer
· Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR
· Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results
· Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data
· High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes
· Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings
How to Apply
Submit your CV  in English , and  one paragraph describing how you would approach the  first 60 days after a new client’s go-live in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Brazil - remote: tech lead
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:
Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture. Frontend: Building the " Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
Dev Ops: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments. Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s " Visualizations" and that the " Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by Dev Ops.
What You’ll Do Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph . Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (Fast API), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates. The " Expert": When the Dev Ops engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.
Qualifications
Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams. Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development . Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading). Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes). Familiarity with Dev Ops/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD). Advanced English communication skills.
Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (Timescale DB, Influx DB). Gen AI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (Lang Graph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Experience with Digital Twins , Io T, or Industrial Data. Experience with Gen AI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents). Background in Heavy Industry, O& G, or Io T data (MQTT, OPC UA).
Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
The Technology Stack
You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:
Backend: Python 3.12+ (Fast API), Kafka, Neo4j, Lang Graph. Frontend: Angular 16+, Type Script, Rx JS, Plotly.js. Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud
Desired Profile The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query. The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (Ng Rx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm Yipit Data. (See this from Spend Hound’s Senior Product Manager!)

title: Engenheiro de dados especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema Saa S da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.
Missão da função
Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.
Reporte e interfaces
Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno
Principais responsabilidades
Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)

Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, Whats App, Linked In, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.
Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial

Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.
Negociação e fechamento

Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.
Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado

Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.
Metas e indicadores (referência)

Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.
Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em vendas B2 B outbound (perfil hunter).
Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.
Diferenciais (alto peso)

Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
TMS (Transportation Management System)
WMS (Warehouse Management System)
DMS (Delivery Management System)
YMS (Yard Management System)
Roteirização e otimização logística
Plataformas Saa S para logística, transporte e supply chain
Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
Experiência em vendas de software Saa S e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).
Exclusividade e conflito de interesses

Não há exigência de exclusividade.
O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.
Modelo de remuneração
Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre: Receita recorrente (MRR)
Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.
Suporte da Mobiis

Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Analista de devops pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃ O DA VAGA:
Responsável por promover a cultura Dev Ops através da disseminação de valores, princípios e práticas Dev Ops, com o objetivo de impulsionar a excelência operacional e maximizar a entrega de valor para os segmentos.
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:
Auxiliar diferentes times de desenvolvimento de software, por meio da disseminação da cultura, ferramentas e práticas Dev Ops;

Preservar os padrões estabelecidos corporativamente, por meio da orientação da importância da utilização dos mesmos e controle para identificar desvios nos processos;
Suportar processos de Dev Ops, através de ferramentas corporativas e boas práticas de mercado;
Elaborar apresentações técnicas, através de análise crítica sobre o tema abordado;
Apoiar o uso das ferramentas corporativas de Dev Ops, por meio de controles técnicos e acompanhamento de chamados;
Apoiar em migrações de ferramentas, por meio de participações em agendas para levantamento ou execução de atividades;

● Ferramentas de CI/CD (Ex: Azure Devops, Git Hub, Git Lab) - Nível Intermediário

● Ferramentas de Qualidade de Código (Ex: Sonar Qube, Checkmarx) - Desejável

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.
E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.
Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Bons conhecimentos em peças de CRM, mídia e social - campanhas digitais.
Pacote Office;
Excelente conhecimento da língua portuguesa;
Criação de textos para banners, e-mails e sites;
Roteiros simples e mini vídeos;
Bom senso estético;
CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.
O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção apaixonada por diversidade e inclusão, com experiência em conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, especialmente em ambientes com alto volume de vagas e perfis variados. Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para profissionais PCDs que desejam fazer a diferença promovendo um ambiente mais plural e representativo.

Responsabilidades

Desenvolver estratégias de atração com foco em diversidade;
Realizar triagens, entrevistas por competências e dinâmicas de grupo;
Apoiar na construção de parcerias com consultorias e instituições voltadas à inclusão;
Garantir uma experiência positiva para todas as pessoas candidatas;
Alimentar e manter atualizados os sistemas de recrutamento (ATS);

Ensino superior completo em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia com recrutamento e seleção, especialmente em vagas de volume;
Conhecimento em entrevistas por competências e ferramentas de avaliação comportamental;

title: Senior visual designer
description:
What is Teachable?
Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?
Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!
About your team
Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.
What is the role?
We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.
This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.
While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.
In this role, you will:

Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows
What you’ll bring:

Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.
Nice to have:
Experience working in Saa S, edtech, or within the creator economy.
Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.
While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Senior cloud engineer
description:
English-speaking Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure or AWS)
$4,000 – $6,000 USD/month
Fully Remote
Full-time, long-term contract
Excellent English skills required for this position
About the Company
Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP that delivers end-to-end cloud solutions to enterprise clients across the US.
Their teams design, manage, and optimize complex Azure and AWS environments for global organizations — helping businesses modernize infrastructure, reduce costs, and adopt automation-first cloud operations.
You’ll be part of a senior, high-performing Cloud Center of Excellence : a small, elite group of engineers who are the “go-to” specialists when others can’t solve it.
This is a long-term, stable remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class engineering environment — without the red tape or endless ticket queues.
The Role
As a Senior Cloud Engineer , you’ll act as both an engineer and consultant — supporting, optimizing, and automating large-scale public cloud environments across Azure and AWS .
This is not a traditional support role — you’ll have direct customer interaction, ownership of infrastructure automation, and the freedom to solve complex challenges creatively.
You’ll work on:
Supporting and optimizing enterprise-scale Azure and AWS environments Building automation frameworks using Terraform, Ansible, and Git Ops principles Proactive governance and cost optimization reviews using Cloud Insights (Flexera Cloud Checkr) Designing and deploying Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Formation, ARM/Bicep) Advising customers on modernization, containers (AKS/EKS), and cloud-native adoption
Collaborating with Product and Professional Services teams on new initiatives and deployments
What You’ll Bring
5+ years’ experience as a Cloud Engineer / Dev Ops / Infrastructure Engineer Strong hands-on expertise in Azure OR AWS (ideally both) Proven experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) Experience with Kubernetes (AKS, EKS) and cloud-native services (App Services, Lambda, etc.) Understanding of networking, hybrid connectivity, and governance best practices Exposure to automation tools such as Ansible, Git Ops, CI/CD pipelines Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment Fluent English communication skills
Who You Are
A problem-solver who loves tackling complex challenges others can’t fix A self-starter who learns fast and enjoys exploring new technologies A consultative communicator , confident working directly with enterprise clients Someone who’s passionate about continuous improvement and multi-cloud growth A team player who wants to be part of a small, world-class engineering group
Why You’ll Love It Here
✅ Work fully remote from anywhere
✅ Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month
✅ Stable, long-term engagement with a US enterprise client base
✅ Strong focus on career development & certifications (covered every 6 months)
✅ Exposure to cutting-edge multi-cloud environments and automation frameworks
✅ Collaborative, senior-level engineering culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
About Shoplift
Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.
Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.
We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.
What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.
As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.
We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.
The Role
As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.
This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.
Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.
The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of "brand recognizes brand" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.
You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

What You'll Do
Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets
Design static ad templates for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency
Brand & Sales Materials
Create feature landing page designs that follow "show-don't-tell" philosophy
Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale
Product Marketing Visualization
Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency
You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

You're a Great Fit If...
Must-haves:
5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio
Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)
Nice-to-haves:
Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
Motion design or animation skills
Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention
You'll thrive if you:
Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
Work well asynchronously across time zones
Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)
What We Offer
Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually
Benefits:
Flexible remote work
Generous time off policy
Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out
Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency
How to Apply
Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:
When submitting you'll be asked to include:
Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work)
A short note and example marketing asset (3-4 sentences): Show us one marketing asset you're proud of and tell us why it worked.
We're excited to meet you!

title: Privacy counsel (full time, remote position)
description:
About Vera Safe: Vera Safe is an innovative and successful U. S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, Vera Safe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.
Watch / listen to learn more about Vera Safe: Check out our podcast! Apple Podcast :
You Tube :
Spotify:
Vera Safe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.
Vera Safe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.
About the Role: This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).
While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).
Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.
We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family.
