title: Sr. desenvolvedor back-end java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!
Sobre a ília
Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.
Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!
#VempraíliaSobre a vaga
O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.
O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.Requisitos
Inglês B2 ou superior.
Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.
Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (ex: Oracle, Postgre SQL) e bancos de dados No SQL (ex: Cosmos DB, Dynamo DB).
Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação como REST e g RPC.
Expertise em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos (event-driven), utilizando ferramentas como Rabbit MQ, Kafka e Amazon SQS.
Experiência na implantação de aplicações em ambientes de Nuvem (AWS ou Azure).
Proficiência em containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
Implementação e automação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, Git Hub Actions ou Argo CD.
Uso avançado de Git e estratégias colaborativas de ramificação (branching) (Gitflow, práticas de code review).
Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging, tais como Prometheus, Grafana e ELK Stack.
Implementação de estratégias de testes robustas (unitário, integração, ponta a ponta/E2 E) utilizando JUnit, Mockito e Testcontainers.
Adoção de boas práticas em TDD/BDD e análise de cobertura de código.
Experiência de trabalho em equipes Ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
Experiência prática com sistemas de alto volume e alta escalabilidade.
Capacidade comprovada de contribuir para refatoração de código, otimização de desempenho e melhorias arquiteturais contínuas.
Compreensão de conceitos de sistemas distribuídos e sua aplicação prática.Diferenciais
Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços complementares em Node.js.
Experiência com plataformas de investimento.
Experiência em ambiente financeiro.
Certificações em Nuvem (Cloud).Benefícios e Incentivos
Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida.Para Saúde e bem-estar:

ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

title: Manufacturing quality and aftersales specialist
description:
About VammoVammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.
Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100 M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, i Food, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region's most vulnerable populations.
The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.
About the Role:
As a Manufacturing Quality and Aftersales Specialist, you will play a vital role in our commitment to implementing best practices in quality control. This position is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality standards in our products through collaboration with suppliers, monitoring quality processes, and enhancing our aftersales services. Your contributions will not only enhance our products and services but also strengthen positive relationships with our customers. Job Description:
Collaborate with suppliers to establish clear quality expectations and standards for components and materials.
Evaluate suppliers reports to ensure compliance with quality standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
Monitor the quality processes for incoming materials, documenting and analyzing relevant data and processes.
Manage warranty processes with suppliers, including the preparation and submission of technical reports, claims, and supporting documentation.
Create detailed reports on product quality metrics and supplier performance, identifying trends and opportunities for enhancement.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend actions that improve product quality and customer satisfaction.
Hard Skills:
Experience in quality assurance, supplier management, or a related field within manufacturing or the automotive industry.
Proficiency in quality management systems and reporting tools that facilitate effective data analysis.
Strong analytical skills to assess product performance and identify recurring quality issues.
Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.
Soft Skills:
Highly Disciplined: Demonstrates a strong commitment to accuracy, organization, and consistency in all tasks.
Process-Oriented Thinking: Employs systematic thinking to analyze workflows and enhance problem-solving capabilities, ensuring efficiency in processes.
Attention to Detail: Conducts thorough evaluations of supplier quality and product performance, focusing on delivering high-quality outcomes.
Effective Communication Skills: Communicates clearly and concisely with stakeholders, fostering collaboration and mutual understanding across teams.

description:
About Vammo
Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100 M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, i Food, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.About the Role
As a senior Technical Procurement Specialist at Vammo, you will be responsible in managing the procurement process for technical materials and services that are crucial to our product lineup. You will collaborate with various teams to identify needs, source components, negotiate contracts with our suppliers, and ensure that our purchasing decisions are optimized for both quality and cost-effectiveness.Key Responsibilities
Identify and evaluate potential suppliers for components and parts essential to our products.
Assess suppliers based on their quality standards, pricing, and delivery capabilities to secure optimal partnerships.
Negotiate terms and conditions and manage the procurement process.
Monitor service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure timely delivery and compliance with quality standards.
Work closely with engineering and project management teams to align on technical requirements and specifications.Hard Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related fields.
Proven expertise in technical sourcing and procurement processes.
Proficiency in utilizing procurement software and tools.
Familiarity with the dynamics of the two-wheeler market.
Advanced English proficiency for effective drafting and communication.Soft Skills
Clarity and Precision:Communicates directly and escalates critical issues effectively.
Critical Thinking:Questions assumptions and understands the context before making informed decisions.
Disciplined Curiosity:Learns quickly, asks insightful questions, and applies acquired knowledge.
Ownership Mindset:Engages with every task as a contribution to the company’s overall success.
Process-Oriented Thinking:Analyzes workflows to enhance efficiency and outcomes.
Negotiation Skills:Demonstrates effective negotiation skills to achieve favorable supplier agreements.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Staff/Senior Data Engineer: AI Training Data (2-4 Months Contract)
Location:Remote
Role Type:Contract (2-4 Months)
Time Commitment:40 hrs/week (Full-time availability required)
Compensation:Hyper-competitive hourly rate (matching Tier-1 Staff engineering bands)Experience:6-12+ yearsAbout Bespoke Labs
Bespoke Labs is a premier, VC-backed AI Research lab with an exceptionally talent-dense team of IIT and Ivy League alumni. We don’t just build tooling around AI—we build the massive-scale data systems and reasoning architectures that directly power next-generation models. Our research shapes the frontier of AI: we’ve published breakthroughs like GEPA, driven foundational datasets like Open Thoughts, and shipped state-of-the-art models including Bespoke-Mini Check and Bespoke-Mini Chart. More on our website:)Role Overview
We are looking for a top-tier Senior/Staff Data Engineer for a high-impact, 2-month sprint. You will leverage your deep expertise in enterprise-grade data platforms to architect and build the complex curation systems required for advanced AI model training.
This is not a traditional ETL pipeline role. We need a heavy-hitter who has already operated production data platforms at scale inside large, complex organizations (FAANG, Fortune 100). You will use the mental models, architectural intuition, and coding skills you've developed over your career to generate, transform, and evaluate the data that trains the next generation of AI.What You Will Do (The Contract)
Architect AI-Scale Systems:Design the overarching data architecture and processing topology needed to programmatically curate and shape datasets at TB/PB scale, ensuring low latency and high consistency.
Hands-On Development:Write production-grade code (Python/Scala, Spark) to build custom ingestion logic, highly efficient transformation scripts, and performant data validation checks.
Complex Data Logic:Implement advanced filtering, deduplication, and quality-scoring algorithms at scale, ensuring the resulting data objects are optimized for LLM/ML consumption.
Quality & Performance Tuning:Rigorously test, benchmark, and optimize processing workloads (CPU/memory tuning, partitioning strategies in Spark/Iceberg) to meet aggressive throughput targets.
Domain Subject Matter Expert:Act as the ultimate technical authority on distributed systems, data processing, and cloud structures to ensure the training data factory meets enterprise-grade accuracy.What You Bring to the Table (Your Past Experience)
To be successful in this contract, you must have a track record of:
End-to-End Ownership:Designing and owning enterprise data platforms (batch + streaming).
High-Throughput Processing:Building and operating Kafka-first streaming pipelines.
Lakehouse Architecture:Utilizing Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi for analytics and ML at scale.
Reliability Engineering:Ensuring data reliability through SLAs, monitoring, backfills, and recovery.
Scale:Processing billions of events and managing TB–PB scale data systems.Required Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)
Experience:6+ years of Data Engineering experience.
Seniority:Demonstrated Senior/Staff-level ownership of production data platforms.
Pedigree:Background at Tier-1 enterprises (FAANG, large Saa S, Fortune 100).
Technical Stack:Deep fluency in Python/Scala, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Major Cloud Warehouses (Snowflake, Big Query, Redshift).

title: Data scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist: AI Training Data (2-4 Months Contract)Company:Bespoke Labs (VC-backed; founded by IIT & Ivy League alumni)
Location:Remote
Role Type:Contract (2-4 Months)
Time Commitment:40 hrs/week (Full-time availability required)
Compensation:Hyper-competitive hourly rate (matching top-tier Senior Data Scientist bands)Experience:6+ yearsAbout Bespoke Labs
Bespoke Labs is a premier, VC-backed AI Research lab with an exceptionally talent-dense team of IIT and Ivy League alumni. We don’t just build tooling around AI—we build the massive-scale data systems and reasoning architectures that directly power next-generation models. Our research shapes the frontier of AI: we’ve published breakthroughs like GEPA, driven foundational datasets like Open Thoughts, and shipped state-of-the-art models including Bespoke-Mini Check and Bespoke-Mini Chart. More on our website bespokelabs.ai :)
Role Overview
We are looking for a high-impact Senior Data Scientist for an intensive, 2-month sprint. You will leverage your deep expertise in production-grade machine learning and applied statistics to develop the algorithms and logic that curate and evaluate datasets for advanced AI model training.
This is not a traditional model-building or research role. We need a seasoned practitioner who has already owned the end-to-end DS lifecycle at scale. You will use your intuition for feature engineering, statistical validity, and large-scale data processing to programmatically generate, shape, and validate AI training data.What You Will Do (The Contract)
Algorithm Design:Design and implement custom statistical models and programmatic logic (e.g., anomaly detection, active learning, similarity scoring) to evaluate data quality, complexity, and redundancy at scale.
Hands-on At-Scale Coding:Write scalable Py Spark and Python (Num Py/Pandas) code to apply these algorithms across massive datasets, translating experimental logic into reliable, large-scale workflows.
Metric Formulation:Develop custom quantitative metrics and heuristic benchmarks to rigorously assess the fidelity and suitability of data subsets for specific AI training objectives.
Validation & Iteration:Run high-speed validation cycles, analyzing the output of data-curation algorithms to diagnose skew, bias, or noise, and iteratively refining the logic.
High-Level Curation:Apply Senior-level domain expertise in predictive modeling and feature engineering to ensure the final training inputs meet the strict standards required for state-of-the-art ML systems.What You Bring to the Table (Your Past Experience)
To be successful in this contract, you must have a track record of:
The End-to-End DS Lifecycle:Framing problems, modeling, validation, production, and iteration.
Production Ownership:Building and deploying ML and statistical models on large-scale datasets.
Large-Scale Data Processing:Working with Apache Spark to develop scalable feature pipelines and offline training workflows.
Experimentation:Designing and analyzing rigorous experiments (A/B tests, causal inference).
Impact:Translating complex model outputs into clear product and business decisions.Required Qualifications (Non-Negotiable)
Experience:6+ years as a Data Scientist or Applied Scientist.
Production Background:Proven ownership of models running in production environments.
Applied Statistics:Strong background in applied statistics and experimentation frameworks.
Core Technical Skills
Languages:Python (Num Py, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Py Torch / Tensor Flow) and Strong SQL.
Big Data:Apache Spark (Py Spark or Spark SQL) for large-scale data processing.
Methodologies:Feature engineering, model evaluation, statistical modeling, and hypothesis testing.Strong Signals (Highly Valued)
Scale:Models trained on TB-scale datasets.
Domain Specificity:Experience in high-complexity domains such as: Recommendations, Pricing, Fraud / risk, Search / ranking, or Growth & experimentation.
Collaboration:Experience deploying models alongside data engineering pipelines.Out of Scope (Who Should Not Apply)
BI / reporting-only roles
SQL-only analysts
Research-only ML roles with no production ownership
Early-career profiles

title: Analista de compras aeronáuticas
description:
Sobre a EmpresaUma empresa de referência no setor de transporte aéreo, reconhecida pela excelência em atendimento. Com o apoio estratégico de Claire Joster, especialista em recrutamento, buscamos um profissional técnico para integrar nossa equipe de suprimentos e contribuir para operações de alta performance e segurança.Objetivo da Posição
Responsável pela gestão estratégica de compras de peças, componentes, equipamentos e serviços críticos para a operação e manutenção aeronáutica. O profissional garantirá o equilíbrio entre custo, qualidade e conformidade, assegurando o suporte contínuo às operações de voo e à manutenção da frota, em linha com as rígidas normas do setor (ANAC, FAA, EASA).Responsabilidades e Atribuições
Executar todo o ciclo de compras: identificação de necessidade, cotação, negociação, aquisição e acompanhamento de entregas de materiais aeronáuticos e serviços especializados.
Analisar especificações técnicas e desenhos de engenharia para validar a conformidade de itens com os requisitos de segurança e qualidade.
Desenvolver e gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores homologados nacionais e internacionais, assegurando performance e parcerias estratégicas.
Elaborar e administrar contratos de fornecimento, com atenção a cláusulas técnicas, de segurança e comerciais.
Colaborar diretamente com as equipes de Engenharia, Manutenção (MRO) e Planejamento para alinhar demandas, prazos e especificações.
Implementar iniciativas de redução de custos e otimização de processos de suprimentos, sem comprometer a integridade operacional.
Gerenciar os níveis de estoque de peças críticas, prevenindo situações de ruptura (AOG – Aircraft on Ground) e otimizando o capital.
Assegurar a conformidade de todos os processos com as regulamentações aeronáuticas vigentes e com os procedimentos internos de qualidade e segurança.
Dominar o uso de sistemas de gestão (ERP, SAP) e plataformas especializadas do setor (ex.: ILS, Aero Xchange) para cadastro, rastreamento e aquisição de peças.
Atuar como ponto de contato técnico-comercial para resolver problemas de qualidade, atrasos ou não-conformidades com fornecedores.Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência Comprovadaem funções de compras, suprimentos ou supply chainno setor de transporte aéreo, aviação ou aeroespacial.
Conhecimento sólido das normas regulatórias da aviação civil (ANAC, FAA, EASA).
Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de documentação técnica (manuais, catálogos de peças, desenhos) eminglês.
Habilidade avançada em ferramentas de gestão e análise: ERP (SAP, Oracle, TOTVS) e Excel (funções complexas, dashboards).
Competências sólidas em negociação estratégica, análise de custos e gestão de contratos.
Perfil proativo, analítico e com orientação rigorosa para detalhes, essencial em um ambiente de alta criticidade.Diferenciais (Desejáveis)
Pós-graduação ou certificações em Compras, Supply Chain Management ou Gestão de Projetos.
Experiência com processos de importação/exportação de peças aeronáuticas e trâmites aduaneiros.
Conhecimento em sistemas de catálogos de peças aeronáuticas (Parts Base, Inventory Locator Service).
Vivência em processos de homologação e auditoria de fornecedores no setor aeroespacial.
Inglês fluente para comunicação comercial e técnica com fornecedores internacionais.Competências Comportamentais
Pensamento Crítico e Resolução de Problemas:capacidade de tomar decisões ágeis e precisas sob pressão.
Comunicação Efetiva:habilidade para dialogar com diferentes áreas (técnicas e comerciais) e níveis hierárquicos.
Ética e Integridade Inegociáveis, aderente à cultura de segurança e compliance da aviação.
Organização e Orientação a Prazos:disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas demandas críticas simultaneamente.
Trabalho em Equipe:espírito colaborativo para atuar em um ambiente multidisciplinar e dinâmico.Benefícios

title: Senior visual designer
description:
What is Teachable?Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it. Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?
Part of the globalHotmart Companyportfolio,whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion,Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!About your teamOur Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.What is the role?We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.
This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.
While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.In this role, you will:Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflowsWhat you’ll bring:Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projectsand assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.), plus motion design
Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries;experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.Nice to have:
Experience working in Saa S, edtech, or within the creator economy.
Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as aremote-first culture

title: Chief legal officer
description:
Gold & Aron Conseil is an executive search company. We are recruiting a CLO on behalf of our client.
Our client is a growingBrazilian fintechwith strong social impact and evolving from a startup into a disciplined, institutional-grade organization. In order to accelerate growth even more, the firm is seeking aChief Legal Officer. The Ideal candidate is someone who can lead all legal related initiatives, navigate complex landscapes, build & manage a high performing team, serve as a trusted advisor to the founders and get things done (not as an advisor but as a legal executive-operator).Responsibilities
Manage all legal matters (mostly domestic but some international exposure as well).
Build, structure, and lead a high-performing in-house legal team, including: (i) Defining clear scopes between in-house vs. external counsel; (ii) Hiring, developing, and, when necessary, upgrading talent; (iii) Implementing SLAs, prioritization frameworks, and legal intake processes; (iv) Ensuring legal is a force multiplier, not a bottleneck
Process Professionalization: Transition the legal department from "startup mode" to a disciplined "financial institution standard".
Risk Optimization: Translate legal constraints into business options. Quantify downside, propose alternatives, and recommend paths that maximize long-term enterprise value
Regulatory: Manage the process of applying for SCD (Sociedade de Crédito Direto) License, exposure to Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Open Finance, Consumer protection at scale (BACEN + SENACON dynamics), Structuring new financial products under regulatory ambiguity
Be ready to contribute to potential capital raise/M&A processes, manage data rooms, oversee due diligence, and negotiate complex term sheets.Qualifications
15–20 years of experience.
Ideal candidate will bring a generalist expertise being able to navigate Brazilian Employment law, Tax basics, Contract law (Brazil & International), Regulatory, M&A.
Ideal candidate has a combination of top-tier law firm and in-house
Start-up experience (ideally at a Fintech)
Proven People Leadership
Language: English fluency is a must.
Location: São Paulo. (Hybrid work environment)This role is NOT for:
Pure advisory profiles who prefer external counsel to execution
Lawyers who have not personally built, hired, and performance-managed teams
Professionals uncomfortable making fast risk trade-offs with imperfect information
Candidates who need heavy structure before acting

title: Desenvolvedor fullstack sênior
description:
Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior
Na Serena Energia, usamos tecnologia para viabilizar a transição para uma matriz energética mais limpa, eficiente e sustentável. Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais que conectam a geração de energia renovável à comercialização para clientes finais, atendendo milhares de consumidores, de residências a grandes data centers, no Brasil e nos EUA.
Atuamos em um dos mercados mais regulados e complexos do mundo, o que exige sistemas robustos, escaláveis e confiáveis. Por isso, buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior para atuar na evolução de sistemas distribuídos estratégicos para o negócio, com alto impacto real na operação e nos clientes.Principais Responsabilidades:
Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações fullstack baseadas em sistemas distribuídos;
Atuar na definição e evolução da arquitetura, aplicando SOLID, DDD e Clean Architecture;
Desenvolver backends e APIs escaláveis, seguras e resilientes;
Trabalhar com Postgre SQL, SQL avançado e Mongo DB, garantindo performance e integridade dos dados;
Projetar e implementar integrações entre sistemas e aplicações;
Atuar em ambientes AWS, com arquiteturas cloud-native e serviços gerenciados;
Colaborar com times de produto, dados, operações e negócio na tomada de decisões técnicas;
Garantir requisitos não funcionais como performance, disponibilidade, segurança e observabilidade;
Utilizar inteligência artificial de forma recorrente no desenvolvimento, revisão de código, automação, análise e documentação;
Contribuir para padrões técnicos, diretrizes e melhoria contínua da plataforma.Requisitos Técnicos:
+5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
Experiência prática com sistemas distribuídos e arquiteturas cloud-native;
Domínio de Postgre SQL, SQL avançado e experiência com Mongo DB;
Forte base em boas práticas de engenharia (SOLID, DDD, Clean Architecture);
Experiência com REST APIs, CI/CD e observabilidade;
Capacidade de avaliar trade-offs técnicos e propor soluções alinhadas ao negócio;
Uso consistente de IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software.
Diferenciais:
Experiência no setor de energia, utilities ou ambientes altamente regulados;
Vivência com event-driven architecture e sistemas de mensageria;
Experiência com modernização de sistemas legados;
Ser heavy user e entusiasta de IA no desenvolvimento de software.

title: Sales engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, and Brazilian office in Barueri, SP, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.
The Sales Engineer plays a key role in achieving sales targets for Greenlane’s biogas desulfurization and upgrading systems by combining strong technical expertise with commercial acumen. This role provides vital support to the sales team by developing sales proposals that meet the needs of our customers through a portfolio of configure-to-order products across a number of product lines. You will support the sales process by joining the Commercial Director in customer meetings and completing customer-focused activities necessary to advance opportunities through the sales pipeline. You will also influence the direction of Greenlane’s product roadmap by sharing internally voice-of-customer feedback and engaging with and supporting the global product management team.Key Duties & Responsibilities:Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of Greenlane’s full suite of biogas desulfurization and upgrading technologies and product lines, including product attributes, benefits over the competition, selling features, and configurable parameters, and and apply this knowledge to develop compelling sales proposals for existing and new prospective customers in Brazil and across Latin America.
Maintain and continuously update a database of technical and commercial information to ensure prompt, clear, and accurate responses to client inquiries and to capture voice-of-customer feedback.
Support Commercial Director in customer meetings and on sales calls to progress opportunities through the sales pipeline.
Evaluate and clearly communicate the advantages and trade-offs of various technical solutions to help clients identify the most suitable approach for their specific project requirements.
Differentiate and articulate the value proposition of Greenlane’s solutions compared to competing offerings within the industry.
Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals that effectively translate complex engineering concepts into compelling client-focused solutions.
Ensure that all client interactions are conducted in a professional, organized, and timely manner that reinforces Greenlane’s reputation for integrity, quality, responsiveness, creativity, and thought-leadership.
Foster collaborative relationships with internal teams, EPC´s, suppliers, and customers to ensure alignment and to set up the project execution teams for success.
Proactively identify and recommend improvements to internal processes, workflows, and solution offerings.
Build and maintain strong networks within the biomethane industry to stay informed on emerging technologies, market trends, and potential business opportunities.
Accurately document and manage all sales activities within the company’s CRM system.Qualifications and Experience:Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline) and a minimum of 5 years of experience in a Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales capacity within a technology-driven environment, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Technical expertise in air or gas compression, purification, treatment, or separation—ideally with exposure to natural gas or biomethane applications.
Professional working proficiency in Portuguese, English, and Spanish.
Strong understanding of solution-based selling, including the ability to identify customer pain points and communicate how Greenlane’s technology uniquely meets their needs.
Familiarity with the biogas and biomethane markets in Brazil is a strong asset.
Self-motivated, resourceful, proactive, and passionate about clean technology, with a proven record of delivering customer-focused solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and rapport across multiple organizational levels.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities with a track record of managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.
A collaborative, positive, and proactive team player who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.How to Apply:

title: Senior splunk engineer
description:
OverviewWe are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.Responsibilities
1. Plan & Build
Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
Build trend and capacity analyses.2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)
Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.3. Configuration & Release Management
Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.4. Security, Hardening & Compliance
System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, Su SSHi, 2 FA).
Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
Automate SOP-based operational workflows.5. Transition
Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.Requirements
Technical Skills
5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.Certifications (required)
Minimum two of:
Splunk Core Certified User
Splunk Core Certified Power User
Splunk Enterprise Admin
Splunk Enterprise Architect
Optional: Splunk ESSoft Skills
Strong communication in enterprise environments.
Clear documentation skills.
Proactive, quality-driven work style.
Fluent English (German beneficial).

title: Analista de gestÃo financeira de projetos sÊnior
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S. A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.MISSÃO DO CARGO
Responsável pelo acompanhamento financeiro e apoio no orçamento anual dos novos shoppings, expansões, projetos VGVs, e torres. Elaboração dos relatórios das performances de projeto;
Acompanhamento das change orders dos projetos (novos shoppings e expansão), acompanhamento dos projetos - obra e a comercialização de espaços, CAPEX e Receitas, apoio para a reunião de performance dos novos projetos, apoio na preparação dos relatórios para os Comitês, apoio no SAP: relatórios para a Performance de Projetos, apoio no Orçamento de DGI e projetos.
RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?
Analisar e acompanhar CAPEX;
Projeção dos valores atualizados mensalmente pelas áreas na planilha CAPEX para projeção do Cash da empresa;
Monitorar performance dos projetos;
Controlar aspectos financeiros dos projetos;
Avaliar viabilidade e calcular taxa interna de retorno (TIR);
Conhecimento em Project Finance;
Atuar em alinhamento com áreas de planejamento estratégico e integrado;
Acompanhamento dos projetos e preparação da pauta das RE's de performance de projetos, obras relevantes e pequenas reformas;
Interface com área de Controladoria;
Reportar performance ao Gerente PMO;
Elaborar apresentações (PPT) para o CEO.
OBSERVAÇÕES
Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia, ou Economia;
Experiência com SAP e integração de sistemas;
Excel avançado (acompanhamento de pagamentos, análises, relatórios);
Conhecimento em gestão de projetos;
Experiência prévia em empresas de projetos imobiliários (diferencial, não obrigatório);
Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados;
Forte habilidade de relacionamento para interação com diversas áreas;
Boa comunicação e dicção clara para apresentações e alinhamentos.

title: Analista fiscal
description:
Objetivo da PosiçãoO Analista Fiscal será responsável por garantir a conformidade tributária da empresa, assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações fiscais, atuação junto à Contabilidade para apuração de impostos e suporte às áreas contábil e financeira. Atuará como elo entre a organização, a contabilidade externa e os órgãos reguladores, minimizando riscos e otimizando processos.Principais Responsabilidades
Verificação da Apuração de impostos feito pela Contabilidade Externa: ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL e demais tributos diretos e indiretos.
Atuação junto à Contabilidade Externa para as Obrigações acessórias: elaboração e entrega de SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, DIRF e demais declarações exigidas pela legislação.
Conciliação fiscal: análise e conferência de lançamentos contábeis relacionados a tributos.
Gestão de notas fiscais: Lançamento das Notas Fiscais de entradas e emissão de Notas Fiscais de venda (serviços e produtos), escrituração de notas fiscais de entrada e saída, conferência de impostos destacados e validação de créditos tributários.
Atualização legislativa: acompanhamento de mudanças na legislação tributária e implementação de ajustes nos processos internos.
Planejamento tributário: apoio na identificação de oportunidades de economia fiscal e otimização de processos.
Relacionamento com órgãos públicos: interação com Receita Federal, Secretarias da Fazenda e demais entidades reguladoras.Requisitos
Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Direito
Experiência prévia em rotinas fiscais e tributárias.
Conhecimento em legislação tributária brasileira e obrigações acessórias.
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de escrituração fiscal (desejável conhecimento do sistema OMIE).
Excel intermediário/avançado para análises e relatórios.
Perfil analítico, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de trabalhar sob prazos.Competências Comportamentais
Organização e disciplina.
Capacidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas.
Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
Proatividade e atualização constante sobre legislação.Local de Trabalho
Região da Berrini em São Paulo

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company DescriptionEMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.You Are
An experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.
You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work.Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.Responsibilities
Design graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without frictionQualifications
Strong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

title: Analista de engenharia de dados pleno
description:
Buscamos um profissional com perfil \"End-to-End\" para atuar nainterseção entre Engenharia de Dados e Business Intelligence. Sua missão será conectar o
mundo técnico do Databricks com a camada de decisão no Power BI. Você não apenas
validará os dados, mas atuará na construção das tabelas finais (Gold Layer) e no
desenvolvimento de dashboards performáticos, garantindo que a visualização reflita com
precisão as regras de negócio de Mídia.
Principais atribuições:
• Atuar na engenharia e modelagem de dados no Databricks (SQL/Py Spark), realizando transformação de dados e criação/otimização de views e tabelas na camada Gold.
• Desenvolver e manter modelagens dimensionais (Star Schema/Snowflake) para garantir performance e eficiência no consumo via Power BI.
• Implementar e automatizar regras de negócio diretamente na origem, estruturando cálculos e tratamentos para eliminar ajustes manuais no Power Query.
• Criar dashboards executivos e operacionais no Power BI com alto padrão visual, storytelling e melhores práticas de UX/UI.
• Desenvolver medidas avançadas em DAX para análises complexas, incluindo KPIs de mídia como Year-over-Year, Share of Voice e indicadores acumulados.
• Realizar manutenção evolutiva de relatórios existentes, assegurando consistência técnica e visual conforme novas demandas do negócio surgirem.
• Conduzir análises e troubleshooting ponta a ponta, investigando divergências desde medidas DAX até queries SQL no Data Lake.
• Gerenciar governança dos workspaces no Power BI Service, incluindo organização de publicações, controle de acessos e atualização de datasets.
Requisitos
• Power BI em nível intermediário, com domínio de linguagem DAX, conhecimento em Power Query (M) e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (relacionamentos, cardinalidade, desempenho e otimização de datasets).
• SQL em nível intermediário/avançado, com habilidade para escrever queries complexas, incluindo CTEs e Window Functions, para manipulação de dados e validação de regras de negócio.
• Experiência intermediária com Databricks e Py Spark, incluindo uso de notebooks, leitura de tabelas Delta e manipulação básica de Data Frames (filtro, agregações e tratamentos via código).
• Entendimento sólido de pipelines de dados, compreendendo as etapas de ingestão, tratamento e visualização, e sabendo identificar onde atuar quando ocorre alguma falha no fluxo.
Diferenciais:
• Vivência com dados de marketing digital e mídia (Google Ads, Meta, DV360, entre outras plataformas).
• Conhecimento em Python para criação de scripts auxiliares.

Experience working in fast-growing or scale-up environments.

title: Thumbnail designer (art director) - crypto media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top You Tube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto. Today, with 80+ team members and over 10 M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!
Role Overview
Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.What you’ll do

title: It operations manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning: Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization. IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects. Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies. Our Core Focuses: End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity. Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs. Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices. We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.
Job Responsibilities:
1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.
2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.
3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.
4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.
5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.
6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.
7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.
8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.
9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.
10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.
